name: m4-02-1
title: Pipeline anatomy
spec:
flowchart LR
  A["Pull request"] --> B["Static analysis\nfmt, validate, lint, yamllint, shellcheck"]
  B --> C["Security & secrets scan\ngitleaks, trivy/checkov, tfsec"]
  C --> D["Plan / dry-run / diff\nterraform plan, ansible --check, helm template"]
  D --> E["Policy as code\nOPA/Conftest, Sentinel, cost checks"]
  E --> F["Unit / integration tests\nmolecule, terratest, kind"]
  F --> G["Human review + approval\nCODEOWNERS, environment gates"]
  G --> H["Merge to main"]
  H --> I["Deploy: apply saved plan\nstaging then canary then fleet"]
  I --> J["Verify\nsmoke tests, health checks, SLO watch"]
  J -->|fail| K["Rollback / stop the line"]
  J -->|ok| L["Promote next env"]

name: m4-02-3
title: Rolling out to physical and large fleets
spec:
flowchart TB
  A["Merge approved change"] --> B["Canary: 1-2 nodes\n(drain from scheduler first)"]
  B --> C{"Validation passes?\nhealth, DCGM, NCCL, SLO"}
  C -- no --> X["Stop the line: halt, restore canary, open incident"]
  C -- yes --> D["Manual approval gate (optional)"]
  D --> E["Batch 1: e.g. 5% of nodes"]
  E --> F{"Healthy after soak?"}
  F -- no --> X
  F -- yes --> G["Batches of N with serial and max_fail_percentage"]
  G --> H["Fleet complete; update inventory/version pin"]

name: m4-03-1
title: How Ansible executes a task
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Control node (ansible-playbook)
  participant T as Target host
  C->>C: Parse playbook, load inventory, resolve variables, template task args
  C->>T: SSH connect (multiplexed ControlPersist)
  C->>T: Copy temp module payload (AnsiballZ zip of module + helpers) to ~/.ansible/tmp
  C->>T: Execute with remote Python (possibly via sudo/become)
  T->>T: Module inspects state, changes if needed, prints JSON
  T-->>C: JSON result (changed/failed, facts, return values)
  C->>T: Remove temp files
  C->>C: Register result, evaluate handlers/conditionals, next task

    L3 --> L4["4. Host facts (setup) & registered / set_fact vars"]
    L4 --> L5["5. Play vars / vars_files & Role vars (roles/x/vars/main.yml)"]
    L5 --> L6["6. Block & Task vars / include_vars / role params"]

name: m4-17-1
title: The node bring-up dependency graph
spec:
flowchart TB
  F["Firmware & BIOS\n(virtualisation/IOMMU, SR-IOV, NPS, power profile, PCIe settings)"] --> OS["OS install / image\n(kernel, headers, base packages, time sync, users)"]
  OS --> K["Kernel params & tuning\n(hugepages, IOMMU, isolcpus, sysctl, limits)"]
  K --> OFED["MLNX_OFED / DOCA\n(RDMA, ConnectX/BlueField drivers)"]
  OFED --> R1(("reboot / module reload"))
  R1 --> DRV["NVIDIA driver\n(open or proprietary; DKMS or precompiled)"]
  DRV --> R2(("reboot / reload"))
  R2 --> FM["Fabric Manager\n(NVSwitch systems)"]
  DRV --> PM["nvidia-persistenced\npersistence mode, clocks, power cap, MIG"]
  DRV --> PEER["nvidia-peermem / GDRCopy\n(GPUDirect RDMA)"]
  FM --> DCGM["DCGM + exporter\n(telemetry, health)"]
  PM --> DCGM
  PEER --> CT["Container toolkit\n(runtime config)"]
  DCGM --> VAL["Validation & burn-in\n(DCGM diag, NCCL tests)"]
  CT --> VAL
  VAL --> SCH["Scheduler / Kubernetes agent\n(slurmd, kubelet, GPU Operator parts)"]
  SCH --> OK["Node released to workloads"]

name: m4-22-2
title: Putting it together: a secure pipeline sketch
spec:
flowchart LR
  PR["Pull request"] --> PLAN["Plan job\nOIDC → read-only role\nstate read, no secrets in artefact"]

  POL --> APPROVE["Approval gate (prod)"]
  APPROVE --> APPLY["Apply job (protected branch)\nOIDC → env-specific write role"]
  APPLY --> SM[("Secret manager\nvalues set out-of-band")]
  APPLY --> ST[("Encrypted remote state\nrestricted access")]

name: m4-23-2
title: Change lifecycle
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Dev
  participant Git as Git (PR)
  participant CI
  participant Rev as Reviewers (CODEOWNERS)
  participant Env as Environment
  Dev->>Git: branch, change code, open PR
  Git->>CI: fmt, validate, lint, scan, tests
  CI->>CI: plan per affected stack (read-only identity)
  CI->>Git: post plan summary + policy results
  Rev->>Git: review code + plan (blast radius, replacements, cost)
  Git->>CI: merge to main
  CI->>Env: apply saved plan in staging
  CI->>CI: verify (smoke), soak
  CI->>Env: apply to prod behind approval gate
  CI->>Git: record apply result, update change log

name: m4-24-1
title: Designing the landing zone (GCP)

flowchart TB

  PRJ --> NET["VPC: custom subnets\nprivate Google access, Cloud NAT, firewall"]
  NET --> GKE["GKE cluster (private nodes)\nsystem pool + GPU pools"]
  NET --> VMS["GPU VMs / Slurm cluster\n(compact placement, multi-NIC)"]
  PRJ --> ST["GCS buckets: datasets, checkpoints\nCMEK, versioning, uniform access"]
  PRJ --> IAM["Service accounts + Workload Identity\nno JSON keys"]
  PRJ --> AR["Artifact Registry (images)"]
  PRJ --> MON["Cloud Monitoring/Logging,\nbudgets & alerts"]

name: m4-26-1
title: GitOps principles and architecture
spec:
flowchart LR
  Dev["Engineer"] -- "PR + review" --> Config["Git: config repo\n(desired state)"]
  CI["CI (build, test, scan)"] -- "build image, push registry\nopen PR bumping tag/digest" --> Config
  Config -- "poll / webhook" --> Ctl["GitOps controller in cluster\n(Argo CD / Flux)"]

name: m4-26-2
title: Bootstrapping a GPU platform: ordering
spec:
flowchart TB
  W0["Wave 0: namespaces, PSA labels, priority classes, CRDs for operators"] --> W1["Wave 1: cert-manager, CSI drivers, storage classes, monitoring CRDs (Prometheus Operator)"]

  W3 --> W4["Wave 4: policies (Kyverno/Gatekeeper), tenancy (namespaces, quotas, LocalQueues)"]
  W4 --> W5["Wave 5: apps: inference gateways, pipelines, dashboards"]
